description:
Bulk-import a spreadsheet into SimplifyQA — the MCP equivalent of the UI's Import.
`kind:"testcases"` — one MANUAL test case per row. Recognised headers (case/spacing-insensitive): `name`/`title` (required), `description`, `steps` (one step per line, or `|` separated), `expected result`, `module`, `story`/`userstory`, `prerequisites`. A step column is prose, so the imported cases are MANUAL (automation needs real locators — record those).
`kind:"testdata"` — one ITERATION per row for ONE test case: needs `tcId` + `environmentType`; every column is a parameter name (matched case-insensitively).
`kind:"plan_entries"` — the first column is a test case code/id; needs `planId` (execution plan).
Reports what was created / added and every rejected row with its reason. `dryRun:true` parses + reports without writing. The first row is the header unless `headerRow:false`.

dryRun.description: Parse and report only — nothing is written.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx / .csv / .tsv file on this machine.

headerRow.description: Treat the first row as headers (default true).

module.description: testcases: default module/folder id or name for rows without a module column.

storyRef.description: testcases: default user story id/code for rows without a story column.

tcId.description: testdata: the target test case (id or code).

name: excel_import
title: Import test cases / test data / plan entries from a spreadsheet (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv)
